title: Pest and Rodent Control Services and Inspections - Bushland TX
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH SERVICE.USDA ARS AFM APD
description_text: Description – Rodent and Pest Control Service This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 1232SA26Q0404 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ) for Rodent and Pest Control Services for a duration of one base year and four option periods. This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 561710 The small business size standard is $17.5 million This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency. All offers must be sent to Contracting Specialist Shane Pope at shane.pope@usda.gov no later than 16 April 2026 at 1700 hrs CDT. A mandatory site visit is scheduled at the facility location on 09 April 2026 at 10:00 AM CDT. coordination must be made with Banghart, Lloyd - REE-ARS lloyd.banghart@usda.gov 806-356-5716 NLT 015 April 2026 at 15:00 hrs PM CDT
